description: This file implements the SerialPort class and related functionality for serial communication, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, as well as a SerialMonitor class for monitoring serial ports on Windows.

classes.description: A class for monitoring serial ports on Windows, managing registered ports and handling asynchronous I/O events.
